description: This file defines a custom revision entity class for Hibernate Envers, extending the DefaultRevisionEntity to include additional metadata such as who changed the entity and when.

classes.name: OpenmrsRevisionEntity
classes.description: A custom Hibernate Envers revision entity that extends DefaultRevisionEntity to include user and timestamp metadata for revisions.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user ID who made the change.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user ID who made the change.

methods.name: getChangedOn
methods.description: Returns the date when the change occurred.

methods.name: setChangedOn
methods.description: Sets the date when the change occurred.
